comment: Directives are executed by any agent whose tier >= directive.complexity; each agent acts on the most complex directive it is licensed for. The goal is the standing goal seeded at /seed; more arrive via `slime.py ask`.

directives.desc: Base replica: heartbeat, carry a shard of the next tier, and answer the easy subtasks posted for subagents.
Mid tier: same serving behaviour; licensed for the hard subtasks too, and takes them first.
Top tier: take a goal, split it into subtasks for the lower tiers, collect their answers and synthesise the result.

goal.text: How could a swarm of small language models running on old CPU-only laptops cooperate to answer questions better than any one of them alone? Cover how work is split, how answers are checked, and what happens when a laptop drops out.
